adjudication.rationale: In the new component `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` without any `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which ends with `.catch(popupAjaxError)`).
